home.title: A biodata your family will be proud to share
home.lede: Choose a beautiful design, add your details, and download a print-ready marriage biodata in English, Hindi, or Marathi.
home.how1Body: {count} designs, from devotional layouts with Ganesha, Krishna, Shiva and more to modern and minimal styles, plus layouts made first for Hindi and for Marathi.
home.how2Body: Share only what you want. Horoscope, contact and partner preferences are optional, and the preview updates as you type.
home.how3Body: A sharp A4 PDF, ready to print or send on WhatsApp. If a download fails, try again without paying twice.
home.langBody: Switch the document between English, Hindi and Marathi at any time. We translate the labels; names and everything you write stay exactly as you typed them.
home.stylesTitle: Find a style that suits you
home.privacyBody: A biodata is personal. We collect only what goes on the document, and keep it only as long as you need it.

home.privacy2Body: Your details and PDF are erased 14 days after purchase, or the moment you ask.
home.privacy3Title: Never used for ads or AI training
home.privacy3Body: Your biodata is used to make your PDF and nothing else.
home.privacy4Body: This isn't a matchmaking site. Nobody can search for you here.
home.priceTitle: One price per PDF, no subscription
home.priceFoot: Every purchase includes 5 downloads over 14 days and 2 free edits.

pricing.title: One price per PDF, no subscription
pricing.lede: You pay once for the document you choose. There is no account, no renewal and nothing to cancel.
pricing.inc1: A print-ready A4 PDF with selectable text
pricing.inc3: 2 free edits, for a typo or a changed phone number
pricing.inc4: A re-render at no cost if the PDF fails
pricing.inc5: Your details deleted after 14 days, or sooner if you ask
pricing.ni2: Matchmaking, listings or sharing your biodata with anyone
pricing.ni3: Design changes beyond the colours each template offers
pricing.taxNote: Prices include GST where it applies. [Tax note to be confirmed with your accountant.]
pricing.refundBody: If the PDF never renders, we refund in full. Once you have downloaded a correct PDF we cannot take it back, so the preview is deliberately complete.

faq.title: Questions families ask
faq.lede: If something here does not answer it, write to us and a person will reply.
faq.a1: No. You fill in the form, pay once and get a link. The link is what brings you back to your order, so keep it.
faq.q2: Where are my details stored while I type?
faq.a2: In your own browser, on your own device. Nothing reaches our server until you choose Review and pay.
faq.a3: Yes, twice, at no cost. That covers a typo or a changed phone number. The template and the language can be changed too.
faq.q4: Will Hindi and Marathi print correctly?
faq.a4: Yes. The fonts cover Devanagari conjuncts, and the editor stops you before a character that would print as an empty box reaches the PDF.
faq.q5: Can I print it at home?
faq.a5: Yes. It is A4 with the border held well inside what a home printer can reach. The devotional watermarks are deliberately dark enough to survive an inkjet.
faq.a6: No. We make documents. There is no profile, no search and nobody can find you here.
faq.a7: It is deleted 14 days after purchase, or immediately if you ask on your order page.
faq.a8: UPI, cards, net banking and wallets, through Razorpay. We never see your card details.

contact.findOrderBody: Paste the link you were given after paying. We cannot look up an order without it, because there is no account to search.

legal.title: Privacy, terms and refunds
legal.lede: The plain-language summary is first. The formal text follows it.
legal.s1: We collect only what goes on your biodata, plus the payment reference Razorpay gives us.
legal.s2: Your details stay in your browser until you choose Review and pay.
legal.s3: We delete your details and PDF 14 days after purchase, or immediately if you ask.
legal.s4: We never sell your data, show you ads or use your biodata to train anything.
legal.s5: If the PDF never renders, you get a full refund.
